_comment: MERGE these into dorian-agent's EXISTING Slack app manifest. Do NOT paste as a whole new app, and do NOT remove dorian's existing bot scopes / socket-mode settings. Open the app at https://api.slack.com/apps -> your dorian app -> App Manifest, then: (1) add the `user` array under oauth_config.scopes alongside the existing `bot` array, and (2) add `redirect_urls` under oauth_config. Save. No bot reinstall is needed; adding user scopes does not touch the xoxb- token or the socket connection.
